spreadsheets.label: Excel & Spreadsheets
spreadsheets.description: Merge, compare, and clean Excel and table data.

documents.label: Documents & PDF
documents.description: Edit, compare, generate, and convert documents.

media.label: Image, Video & Audio
media.description: Edit images, videos, and audio directly in your browser.

text-data.label: Text & Code
text-data.description: Format and organize text and code data for readability.

work.label: Dates & Calculators
work.description: Calculate workdays, time zones, and payroll easily.

security-share.label: Security & Sharing
security-share.description: Protect privacy and generate secure passwords or QR codes.

document-redactor.title: Redact Personal Info from PDF and Images
document-redactor.description: Safely blackout sensitive personal information on PDF and image files, and save the redacted copies securely.

excel-merger.title: Merge Excel Files and Sheets
excel-merger.description: Combine multiple Excel files or sheets into a single XLSX file. Preserves formulas and formatting, and supports password-protected files.

excel-compare.title: Compare Excel Files and Data
excel-compare.description: Compare pairs of Excel or CSV files by position or key columns. View differences in values, formulas, and formatting in an XLSX report.

excel-cleaner.title: Batch Clean Excel Data
excel-cleaner.description: Apply 28 different rules such as removing spaces, blank rows, and duplicates to clean up your Excel and CSV files systematically.

pdf-editor.title: Edit and Convert PDF Files
pdf-editor.description: Merge, extract, and convert PDF pages, or use Korean and English OCR to transform them into various document formats.

document-compare.title: Compare Word and HWP Documents
document-compare.description: Compare DOCX, DOC, HWP, or HWPX documents to easily identify differences in paragraphs, tables, and formatting.

pdf-compare.title: Compare PDF File Differences
pdf-compare.description: Compare original and revised PDF pairs to identify page-by-page rendering differences and extracted text changes.

hwp-editor.title: Online HWP Document Editor
hwp-editor.description: Open, edit, and save HWP and HWPX documents directly in your browser with formatting support.

office-editor.title: Online Office Document Editor
office-editor.description: Easily view, edit, and save Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents directly in your web browser.

video-studio.title: Online Video Editor
video-studio.description: Trim, merge, and extract audio from videos. Quickly and easily edit your videos directly in your browser.

audio-studio.title: Online Audio Editor
audio-studio.description: Cut, mute, copy, and paste sections of an audio waveform, or apply pitch adjustment effects to your recordings.

image-studio.title: Online Photo Editor
image-studio.description: A versatile photo editor providing image resizing, cropping, mosaic, filtering, and free-hand drawing features.

text-merger.title: Batch Merge Text Files
text-merger.description: Order multiple TXT files and combine them into a single file using custom separators like line breaks or commas.

text-tools.title: Remove Line Breaks and Spaces
text-tools.description: Remove unnecessary spaces, line breaks, and duplicate lines. Also supports case conversion and Korean grammar checks.

text-formatter.title: JSON, SQL, and XML Formatter
text-formatter.description: Check syntax errors and beautifully indent JSON, SQL, and XML text to make your code neat and readable.

work-calculator.title: Business Day and PTO Calculator
work-calculator.description: Calculate exact business days excluding weekends and Korean public holidays, and estimate PTO based on your start date.

timezone-calculator.title: World Map Timezone Converter
timezone-calculator.description: Select cities on the world map to compare local times and meeting schedules, automatically accounting for UTC and Daylight Saving Time.

payroll-calculator.title: Net Salary and Severance Calculator
payroll-calculator.description: Easily estimate net monthly salary, weekly holiday pay, and legal severance pay based on the latest social insurance rates.

image-privacy.title: Delete Photo Metadata and Location
image-privacy.description: View and completely remove hidden GPS coordinates and camera device information (EXIF) from your photos.

security-tools.title: Secure Password Generator
security-tools.description: Generate random passwords using cryptographically secure numbers, and evaluate their strength with estimated crack times.

qr-studio.title: Create and Scan QR Codes
qr-studio.description: Generate QR codes for URLs and text, or scan existing QR codes using your camera or by uploading images.

data-converter.title: CSV, JSON, and HTML Data Converter
data-converter.description: Freely convert between CSV files, JSON arrays, and HTML table data directly in your browser environment.

document-generator.title: Batch Generate Word Documents
document-generator.description: Automatically generate multiple individualized Word documents at once by replacing template variables with your Excel data.
